_comment: Runtime knobs for state-watch. Cadence is NOT read by the pipeline; the scheduler (GitHub Actions / cron) owns frequency. The fetch block is kept identical to the county repos so the three pipelines stay diffable against each other, even though a 12-target run never approaches these limits. `workers` applies to plain fetches only - headless renders are always serialized to protect determinism.

cadence.note: baseline = daily 08:00 UTC; election window = every 3 hours. The auto window matches fl-county-watch: it opens before Florida's mandatory early voting (Oct 24-31) and closes two weeks after election day so the post-election takedown curve is captured. Authoritative values live in .github/workflows/snapshot.yml; these are documentation.
